messages:
Nora (marketing): Heads-up: plan to ship release 1.4 next Wed. Need final changelog link, docs examples, short benchmark bullets, and webinar demo owner by EOD Mon. Who can take the demo? @Carlos?
Carlos (eng): I can take the live demo. Will show the canary flow + live latency dashboard. Need two quick checks: stable changelog URL and a sample request with new cache header.
Mei (eng): Changelog final draft is at https://redwood.internal/changelog/1.4-draft (for reviewers). Also added the new header: X-Redispatch-Cache with examples.
Zoe (docs): I'll update the API quickstart and add the cache header example in both curl and python. ETA Tue morning. Any copy for the sample payload?
Jules (marketing): For marketing copy we'll want 3 bullets: p50 reduction, token-cost % drop, and throughput improvement. Also a one-liner about private deployment privacy for the post.
Dan (product): Numbers to use in draft: p50 down ~48%, p95 down ~30% on typical 2k seq workload; unit token cost down ~19% with caching + dynamic batching. Use conservative phrasing. I'll DM the spreadsheet.
Nora (marketing): Webinar time preference: 10am PT release day. Carlos to run demo, Dan to do product narrative, Nora will moderate. Need slides + bench charts.
Carlos (eng): Slide needs: architecture snapshot (cache + batching), before/after charts, canary plan. I'll produce the demo script; would like 6-8 min for demo.
Mei (eng): Bench artifacts on S3: s3://bench-artifacts/rls-1709/metrics.csv and plots in s3://bench-artifacts/rls-1709/plots.tar.gz. Use those for slide graphs.
Zoe (docs): Also adding a short 'what changed' section to the changelog page with links to the API examples. Will publish docs at 08:30 PT on release morning so links are live for the webinar.
Jules (marketing): Inbound routing: need a 'Request a demo' CTA that posts utm_campaign=rls-1709 and model_hint params. Who owns webhook integration?
Dan (product): Use sales webhook https://hooks.redwood.com/leads. Sales will route enterprise leads to AEs, others to SDR. Make sure to include lead_source=web and model_hint=redwood-optimized in payload.
Nora (marketing): Can someone verify webhook fires with test data and model_hint included?
Carlos (eng): I'll run an integration test from staging and post the curl command here.
Carlos (eng): curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/leads -d '{"email":"tester@example.com","utm_campaign":"rls-1709","model_hint":"redwood-optimized"}'
deploy-bot: Preflight started: items queued = docs_publish, changelog_pin, cdn_purge, webhook_smoke_test, webinar_slides. Will report back.
Mei (eng): Canary rollout: start at 2% traffic, monitor errors and latency for 15min, escalate to 20% if healthy, full by +90min. Rollback command in runbook: `rb rollback --id rls-1709 --reason "regression"`.
Zoe (docs): Quick note: include legal-approved privacy blurb: "Data remains customer-owned and can be hosted in your VPC for Private deployments." I'll insert that in both the docs and the post copy.
Jules (marketing): Draft social copy ready for review in #marketing-drafts. Will tag for approvals. Need legal blurb present before we schedule.
Nora (marketing): Final owners checklist: slides (Jules), demo script (Carlos), docs publish (Zoe), changelog final pin (Mei), webhook test (Carlos), bench CSV confirmation (Mei). Dry run Saturday 09:00 PT.
Carlos (eng): I'll post the demo script by EOD Mon. Also volunteering for webinar on-call.
Mei (eng): Bench CSV verified. s3 link above contains timestamped runs and baselines.
deploy-bot: Preflight update: docs_publish=queued, changelog_pin=queued, cdn_purge=pending, webhook_smoke_test=running.
Nora (marketing): Great. If anything blocks, reply here and @Nora. Thanks everyone.
